Text: Generates new terrain from the current map with a neural autoencoder.
Smooths the top surface of the whole map with a median filter. Overhangs below the surface are kept.
Generates terrain from 3D noise, with overhangs and floating islands. Hilliness and ruggedness shape the hills.
Base level (3D Noise height at the map bottom)
Generates terrain in the style of other maps by wave function collapse over their terrain patterns.
Solid threshold (share of a block that makes it solid)
Block size (tiles per block and height step)
Height penalty (likelihood per layer away from the source height)
Splits the terrain into flat plateaus with cliffs between them, for easier building. Overhangs below the surface are kept.
Variety (in spreads of the built-in maps)
Carves rivers that start half way up a hill and run downhill to the map edge or a lake, with a water source at each head. Lowers the terrain by at most one block.
Lake size (a basin this big ends a river)
Replaces all trees and bushes with forests and bush patches, denser near water and kept off cliff edges.
